ModManifest.Name: PawnMind · AI Bridge
ModManifest.Author: ygmldr
ModManifest.Description:
Local AI bridge for Probably Stolen.
Exposes a compact snapshot of what the player can already see (shop, dialogue, rent, inventory) plus a whitelisted set of single-step gameplay actions over a loopback-only HTTP endpoint, and mirrors them through a local MCP server.
Security defaults: loopback only, bearer token required, revision and action-id checked on every write, and all write actions stay locked unless bridge.conf explicitly arms the dedicated recording save slot for the exact game version and assembly MVID. The bridge never reads hidden fields (appraisal truth, hidden customer identity, real water composition) and never calls AddCredit.
